findings.location: design.md §2 (How a snapshot is opened) / §9 Change table
findings.problem: The viewer's proposed open-file control uses accept=".json,application/json" while the existing Settings import control uses the stricter accept=".json". The divergence is intentional and justified, but is not flagged as a deliberate difference, so a later reviewer could 'normalise' the two and silently narrow the picker.
findings.fix: Add a one-line task note that the viewer's looser accept is intentional (content is validated by validateSharedPayload regardless of picker MIME) and that the existing Settings import control stays accept=".json".

findings.problem: The always-present-but-empty-safe psychology (psych: string), corruption/sin (numbers), and trappings (Trapping[]) blocks are described as 'rendered when the underlying field is non-empty' in prose only, unlike the gated sections which are pinned to the shared shouldRenderSection predicate. All referenced fields exist, so there is no feasibility gap, but the exact non-empty test is left to interpretation.
findings.fix: State the exact non-empty predicate the viewer uses for each (e.g. psych.trim().length > 0, (corr || sin) > 0, trappings.length > 0) so viewer visibility for these three is as mechanically pinned as the shouldRenderSection sections.
